Datapack for **Minecraft Java 26.3**: beating bosses and boss-like challenges permanently raises
your max health (up to +10 hearts, a bonus for hardcore players), and lit campfires give
Resistance I and slowly heal you.

Works on its own, and picks up optional bosses when installed: the
[yAdventures-bosses](https://github.com/TonybynMp4/yAdventures-bosses) datapack, Friends & Foes,
Nekoma's Fixed, Illager Expansion and Illager Invasion.

**Install:** put `yAdventures-*.zip` in `<world>/datapacks/` and run `/reload` (or restart).
